subject.title: googlechat: deliver media as a text link when attachment upload is unauthorized (app auth)

question: Should maintainers require inspectable live Google Chat app-auth proof before this fallback can be considered for merge, or explicitly waive that proof after the code findings are repaired?
rationale: External PR proof is still only mocked/source-level plus narrative production confirmation, while the change affects message delivery and authorization-failure handling in a real channel.

options.title: Require Inspectable Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Google Chat app-auth screenshot, recording, logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact after repairing the code findings.

options.title: Explicitly Waive Live Proof
options.body: A maintainer may accept source/API-contract proof only after the broad predicate and metadata regression are fixed, with that waiver visible in the merge record.

options.title: Use Another Canonical PR
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers choose the open sibling implementation as the canonical branch and it is refreshed, proof-accepted, and complete.

recommendation.title: Require Inspectable Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Google Chat app-auth screenshot, recording, logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact after repairing the code findings.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across Google Chat API/action/adapter maintenance and is the best available routing owner from the inspected history.
